title: Learn to Look: Watch for When the Conversation Turns Crucial
heading: Chapter 5
chapterLocalFacts: The chapter distinguishes content from conditions and treats skilled conversation as tracking both channels at once.
Silence means withdrawing contribution from the pool.
Violence means forcing meaning into the pool.
Naming masking, avoiding, withdrawing, controlling, labeling, or attacking is meant to interrupt the move early.
bridgeForward: Chapter 6 teaches how to restore safety after the reader has noticed that dialogue has started breaking.
